rows.note: Use 感染 as the all-purpose verb for giving or acquiring an illness and for passing enthusiasm or feelings to someone.

example.english: The flu can infect many people at our company.
example.traditional: 流感可以感染我哋公司好多人。
example.jyutping: lau4 gam2 ho2 ji5 gam2 jim5 ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 hou2 do1 jan4

rows.note: Use 污染 when a pathogen makes an object, food, water, or another substance contaminated rather than infecting a person.

example.english: If raw-meat juice splashes into the salad, it can infect the whole dish.
example.traditional: 生肉汁一濺入沙律，就會污染成碟食物。
example.jyutping: saang1 juk6 zap1 jat1 zin3 jap6 saa1 leot2 zau6 wui5 wu1 jim5 sing4 dip6 sik6 mat6
